title: ML & MLOps Projects
description: Four projects span data pipelines, supervised learning, bike-share demand forecasting, and production MLOps. The deployment project serves predictions through a FastAPI endpoint.
concepts: Storage abstraction across local files and S3
Logistic regression with scikit-learn and from scratch in NumPy
Time-series forecasting with XGBoost and cyclical and lag features

title: WebBoost
description: WebBoost analyzes a blog post URL and returns a weighted score with prioritized recommendations. It checks readability, navigation, and SEO signals such as metadata, indexing, and internal links.
concepts: Combining content, UX, SEO, social integration, and ad intrusiveness into a weighted score
Readability assessment with Flesch, Fog, SMOG, Coleman-Liau, and ARI

title: MediaSleuth360
description: MediaSleuth360 helps you explore uploaded audio or video. Ask a question about the recording and jump to the relevant timestamps.

title: Checkers AI
description: An American checkers game with two AI opponents. It supports mandatory captures, multi-jumps, king promotion, and draw detection.
concepts: Adversarial search with Minimax and alpha-beta pruning
Reinforcement learning with Q-learning against a Minimax opponent

title: Raycasting in Maze
description: A real-time, first-person 3D maze explorer with adjustable field of view, movement speed, and resolution.
concepts: Grid traversal with DDA for raycasting

title: Fylio
description: Fylio replaces local file directory listings in Chromium browsers with a Finder-style interface that supports search and sorting.
concepts: Directory view design with grid and list layouts
Theme switching and color-coded file types
